rubrics.justification: Reasonable caution about single-image limitations, but the description leans on the provided 3AA label more than the image itself; visible ICM/TE characterization is somewhat speculative and expansion is described broadly rather than precisely.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, endometrium, prior cycle history, and smoking with embryo quality and prognosis.
Overall logic is clear and internally consistent, with appropriate emphasis on morphology versus aneuploidy; only minor overstatements around what can be inferred from a single image.

Recommendations are largely consistent with Gardner grading interpretation, SET for good prognosis, and individualized PGT-A discussion; minor limitation is somewhat broad prognostic framing without explicit caveats about fresh versus frozen context.
Provides clear practical next steps for transfer, counseling, lifestyle optimization, luteal support follow-up, and contingency planning for future cycles.
